caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned wooden object resembling a chalice or goblet with a wide, shallow bowl at the top, a narrow cylindrical stem, and a rounded, double-footed base. The object is rendered in shades of brown and tan, exhibiting wood grain patterns throughout its surface. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background. In the top-left corner of the page, there is a small diagram of a circular base with a star-like pattern inside it, and in the top-right corner, there is a small technical outline showing a profile view of the object, annotated with dimensions: 4 inches tall and 3 inches wide at the top. The drawing shows detailed shading to suggest the three-dimensional form of the wooden object. The artist's signature, "Edward Lopez," appears in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Sand Sifter
